document_name: Speed WMS Outbound Data Model — Préparations & Missions

OPE_DAT.description: Order/preparation header — one record per outbound order

columns.name: OPE_KEYU
columns.description: Surrogate unique key — can be used as alternate join key to OPL_DAT

columns.name: VAG_NOVA
columns.description: Wave number — populated when order is in a wave

OPL_DAT.description: Order/preparation lines — one record per article to be picked

columns.name: OPE_KEYU
columns.description: Alternate FK to order header — can be used instead of OPE_NOOE

columns.name: OPL_NOSU
columns.description: Support/pallet number — used for outbound joins

VAG_DAT.description: Wave headers — grouping of multiple orders for picking

MIE_DAT.description: Mission headers — picking tasks assigned to operators

columns.name: MIE_KEYU
columns.description: Surrogate unique key — alternate join key to MIL_DAT

columns.name: VAG_NOVA
columns.description: Wave number this mission belongs to

MIL_DAT.description: Mission lines — individual pick tasks within a mission

columns.name: OPE_NOOE
columns.description: Order number — links back to OPE_DAT

columns.name: OPL_NOOL
columns.description: Order line number — links back to OPL_DAT

columns.name: MIL_SUPP
columns.description: Expedition support number — links to SEX_DAT.SEX_SUPE

SEX_DAT.description: Prepared expedition supports — physical shipping units (pallets, boxes)
SEX_DAT.note: EXCEPTION: SEX_DAT uses SEX_ACT instead of ACT_CODE — this is the only table with this exception

columns.name: SEX_ACT
columns.description: Activity code — NOTE: named SEX_ACT not ACT_CODE (exception to standard naming)

order_header_to_lines.description: Get order with all its lines to pick
order_header_to_lines.alternate_join: OPE.OPE_KEYU = OPL.OPE_KEYU can also be used
order_header_to_lines.example_sql: SELECT ope.OPE_NOOE, ope.OPE_STAT, opl.ART_CODE, opl.OPL_NOOL FROM OPE_DAT ope INNER JOIN OPL_DAT opl ON ope.ACT_CODE = opl.ACT_CODE AND ope.OPE_NOOE = opl.OPE_NOOE WHERE ope.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND ope.OPE_NOOE = :OPE_NOOE

order_to_wave.description: Link order to its wave when order is grouped
order_to_wave.note: OPE_STAT = 020 when order is in a wave; OPE_STAT = 030 when in a mission without wave

wave_to_missions.description: Get all missions for a wave
wave_to_missions.example_sql: SELECT vag.VAG_NOVA, mie.MIE_NOMI, mie.MIE_STAT FROM VAG_DAT vag INNER JOIN MIE_DAT mie ON vag.VAG_NOVA = mie.VAG_NOVA WHERE vag.VAG_NOVA = :VAG_NOVA

mission_header_to_lines.description: Get mission with all its pick lines
mission_header_to_lines.alternate_join: MIE.MIE_KEYU = MIL.MIE_KEYU can also be used
mission_header_to_lines.example_sql: SELECT mie.MIE_NOMI, mie.MIE_STAT, mil.OPE_NOOE, mil.MIL_STAT FROM MIE_DAT mie INNER JOIN MIL_DAT mil ON mie.ACT_CODE = mil.ACT_CODE AND mie.MIE_NOMI = mil.MIE_NOMI WHERE mie.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND mie.MIE_NOMI = :MIE_NOMI

order_lines_to_mission_lines.description: Link order lines to their corresponding mission pick lines
order_lines_to_mission_lines.example_sql: SELECT opl.OPE_NOOE, opl.ART_CODE, mil.MIE_NOMI, mil.MIL_STAT FROM OPL_DAT opl INNER JOIN MIL_DAT mil ON opl.ACT_CODE = mil.ACT_CODE AND opl.OPE_NOOE = mil.OPE_NOOE AND opl.OPL_NOOL = mil.OPL_NOOL WHERE opl.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

mission_lines_to_expedition_support.description: Link mission lines to their expedition support (pallet/box)
mission_lines_to_expedition_support.note: SEX_DAT uses SEX_ACT instead of ACT_CODE — critical exception to remember
mission_lines_to_expedition_support.example_sql: SELECT mil.MIE_NOMI, mil.OPE_NOOE, sex.SEX_SUPE, sex.SEX_STAT FROM MIL_DAT mil INNER JOIN SEX_DAT sex ON mil.ACT_CODE = sex.SEX_ACT AND mil.MIL_SUPP = sex.SEX_SUPE WHERE mil.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

mission_lines_to_racking.description: Get picking address/racking information for mission lines

full_outbound_trace.description: Full outbound trace from order to mission lines
full_outbound_trace.example_sql: SELECT ope.OPE_NOOE, ope.OPE_STAT, opl.ART_CODE, mie.MIE_NOMI, mie.MIE_STAT, mil.MIL_STAT FROM OPE_DAT ope INNER JOIN OPL_DAT opl ON ope.ACT_CODE = opl.ACT_CODE AND ope.OPE_NOOE = opl.OPE_NOOE INNER JOIN MIL_DAT mil ON opl.ACT_CODE = mil.ACT_CODE AND opl.OPE_NOOE = mil.OPE_NOOE AND opl.OPL_NOOL = mil.OPL_NOOL INNER JOIN MIE_DAT mie ON mie.ACT_CODE = mil.ACT_CODE AND mie.MIE_NOMI = mil.MIE_NOMI WHERE ope.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND ope.OPE_NOOE = :OPE_NOOE

query.sql: SELECT ope.OPE_NOOE, ope.OPE_STAT, ope.TIE_CODE FROM OPE_DAT ope WHERE ope.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND ope.OPE_STAT = :OPE_STAT ORDER BY ope.OPE_NOOE;

procedures.business_logic: Get all orders filtered by status. Use reference_codes.OPE_STAT for valid values.

query.sql: SELECT mie.MIE_NOMI, mie.MIE_STAT, mie.VAG_NOVA FROM MIE_DAT mie WHERE mie.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND mie.MIE_STAT IN ('010','020') ORDER BY mie.MIE_NOMI;

procedures.business_logic: Get all missions that are active (to prepare or in preparation).

values.020: En Vague — assigned to a picking wave
values.030: Lancée — launched as a mission (without wave)

MIE_STAT.description: Mission header status field on MIE_DAT

values.020: En cours de préparation — picking in progress
values.060: Mise en expédition — sent to shipping

MIL_STAT.description: Mission line status field on MIL_DAT

values.060: Mise en expédition — sent to shipping

SEX_STAT.description: Expedition support status field on SEX_DAT

TMC_CODE_outbound.description: Movement type codes for outbound stock on MVT_DAT

safety_rules: Always filter by ACT_CODE on every table — critical exception: SEX_DAT uses SEX_ACT not ACT_CODE
OPE_KEYU and MIE_KEYU are valid alternate join keys for their header-line pairs
OPE_STAT becomes 020 when order enters a wave; 030 when mission is created directly without wave
Stock definitive exit: TMV_CODE = 40010 or 40110 depending on whether prepared stock existed
MVT.STK_KEYU = STK.STK_KEYU is the standard movement-to-stock join
Always execute SELECT before UPDATE operations
Do not execute UPDATE in production without approval
